name: 209-mi-document
description: María Ingeniería API de Gestión Documental

scripts.build: prisma generate && npm run clean && tsc --build && npm run copy-schema
scripts.test:block01: npm run test:events && npm run test:review-workflow
scripts.test:block01-db: npm run test:block01 && npm run test:events-db
scripts.rover-publish-staging: rover subgraph publish Maria-Ingenieria@staging --name mi-document --schema ./schema.graphql --routing-url http://localhost:4209
scripts.rover-publish-current: rover subgraph publish Maria-Ingenieria@current --name mi-document --schema ./schema.graphql --routing-url http://localhost:4209
scripts.test:block02: npm run test:block01 && npm run test:project-scope && npm run test:project-settings
scripts.test:block02-db: npm run test:block02 && npm run test:events-db && npm run test:project-scope-db
scripts.test:block02-all: npm run test:block02-db && npm run test:block02-integration
scripts.test:block03: npm run test:block02 && npm run test:revision-scheme && npm run test:step-signature
